extracted.intended_audience: attorneys seeking reinstatement to practice before the USPTO; USPTO enrollment & discipline staff
extracted.subtask_description: Filing and adjudication of a petition for reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58, including supporting affidavit and Director review. The document is an Office of Enrollment and Discipline decision granting reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement (filed and dated)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Arturo Perez-Guerrero dated February 21, 2018.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A formal petition for reinstatement must be filed and dated; the petition is the primary document that initiates consideration for reinstatement by the Office of Enrollment and Discipline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Perez-Guerrero has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An affidavit filed under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 is required as supporting evidence for a reinstatement petition; although the page does not list the affidavit's contents, compliance with § 11.58 is treated as a necessary supporting submission for consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's discretionary review and determination of appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, and the supporting affidavit, the Director of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement of Mr. Perez-Guerrero to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement is subject to the Director's discretionary determination based on review of the petition and supporting materials; the decision may result in reinstatement (GRANTED) or denial. The page records that careful review can lead to a determination that reinstatement is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuance of decision and notice to parties
rubrics_metrics.description: Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED. Copy to: Mr. Arturo Perez-Guererro c/o Michael McCabe McCabe Law LLC ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If reinstatement is granted, the Office issues a written decision reflecting the grant and provides copies/notice to the petitioner and counsel of record (contact information included).
